Subject: Pilot integration delay — request for short extension & credits

Hi Sofia,

Quick update from our side: our backend team hit an unexpected blocker in the payment connector handshake during the QA pass. The engineer estimates another 5–7 business days to finish the fix and run a final round of regression tests. That pushes our internal demo originally slated for 2028-07-08 out of window.

Because the pilot depends on live traffic and the sandbox tokens are depleting, we'd like to request:
- A 14-day extension to the pilot window
- A one-time sandbox top-up (~20k tokens) so our engineers can complete end-to-end verification without interrupting the trial metrics

We're committed to the pilot and want to keep momentum with product and procurement. Can Redwood provision a short runway while we finish the fix? Happy to share the engineer's notes (attached) and hop on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Ethan
